clue.text: Cares about John Dryden's first British play becoming a musical

indicators.note: the word for cares goes round the other pieces, so it sits about them

parts.note: to care or worry about something is to be bothered, so cares gives bothers
john is slang for a lavatory, a loo

indicators.note: first asks for the opening letter of the poet's name

explanation.surface: A literary note on a Dryden drama staged first in Britain and later turned into a musical.
explanation.walkthrough: 'John' is the lavatory, not a first name. Dryden is a red herring too: the play is Willy Russell's, first written for schools before becoming the West End musical.
explanation.definitionFit: Willy Russell's piece about Liverpool twins began as a school play and was then expanded into the famous stage musical.

clue.text: A girl they treated for what isn't really a long time

definitions.text: what isn't really a long time

indicators.note: letters that are treated are processed or worked on, so they come out rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone recalls how a young woman behaved towards them over a period of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Despite the word 'year', this unit measures distance, the span light covers in twelve months, not a duration.

clue.text: Irish-American actress finally taken off for European airport

indicators.note: the last letter of the actress's surname is removed

parts.note: Maureen O'Hara was an Irish-born Hollywood star

explanation.surface: A film star leaves for Europe by plane, her final departure from the screen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally taken off' drops the closing A of O'HARA, leaving OHAR. The European airport looks like the definition but supplies only E; the airport is Chicago's.
explanation.definitionFit: O'Hare International is the main airport serving Chicago, one of the busiest in the world.

clue.text: Initially quoted coppers for a barrister, perhaps, in this

definitions.text: Initially quoted coppers for a barrister, perhaps, in this

parts.words: Initially quoted coppers for a barrister, perhaps, in this
parts.note: the initials of quoted coppers are Q and C, which stand for Queen's Counsel, a senior barrister, written in short form; a barrister's case papers might also quote police officers

explanation.surface: A barrister's paperwork cites the evidence of police officers.
explanation.walkthrough: QC, the initials of 'quoted coppers', is how Queen's Counsel is written 'in this', i.e. in short form. The case document a solicitor sends a barrister has the same name.
explanation.definitionFit: 'In short' is a set phrase with this word, and the instructions a barrister receives for a case carry the same name.

clue.text: Made the most of being work-shy around the Home Counties

parts.note: OP is short for opus, a musical work

indicators.note: the word for shy is placed around the region's letters

parts.note: a shy person is timid
the counties round London lie in the south-east of England, SE

explanation.surface: A description of a lazy commuter-belt lifestyle that somehow got the best out of things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'work-shy' looks like one idea but splits in two; the Home Counties are the counties surrounding London, in England's south-east.
explanation.definitionFit: To optimise something is to make it as effective as possible, getting the best out of it.

clue.text: One in hairy situation due to bad deal getting through Parliament, partly?

indicators.note: the scrambled letters pass into the chamber's name, going through it

parts.note: Parliament has two parts, each a House (Commons and Lords)

indicators.note: a bad deal is a messed-up one, so its letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A political story: someone in a sticky spot because a poor deal is passing through Parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' scrambles the four letters into EADL. 'Hairy situation' is literal: the creature lives among hair, and Parliament has two Houses.
explanation.definitionFit: This parasitic insect lives on the human scalp, literally in a hairy place.

clue.text: Give refreshment to Frenchman and wife

parts.note: René is a typical French man's name

explanation.surface: Offering drinks to a Frenchman and his wife.
explanation.definitionFit: To refresh something is to restore or revive it, which is what renewing does.

clue.text: Reject actor that's broken into vehicles or motor boats

indicators.note: the vehicles are broken into, so the other pieces go inside them

parts.note: cars are vehicles
to reject something is to bin it, throw it away
Tom Cruise is a Hollywood actor

explanation.surface: Turn down a star whose cars or speedboats were burgled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reject' looks like an adjective or a command about the actor, but supplies its own piece; the actor is Tom Cruise.
explanation.definitionFit: Cabin cruisers are motor boats with living accommodation on board.

clue.text: Returning to normal consciousness, hoping destiny has changed

indicators.note: the letters of the two words have changed their order

explanation.surface: Someone coming round, wishing their fate had altered.
explanation.definitionFit: Bringing someone out of a trance restores their normal waking state.

clue.text: Hound setter in foreign capital

parts.note: the Afghan is a breed of hound
the crossword setter refers to themselves as I

explanation.surface: A dog of the setter breed loose in some overseas city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setter' looks like the dog breed beside 'Hound', but is the puzzle's setter, I. 'Capital' means money, not a city.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the currency of Afghanistan, so foreign money, capital in the financial sense.

clue.text: Drops in a letter for one learning the ropes

indicators.note: the drops go in the spelt-out letter

parts.note: the letter T is spelt out as tee
drops falling from the sky are rain

explanation.surface: Someone learning a job drops a letter, perhaps in the postbox.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainee is a novice being taught the basics of a job.

clue.text: Expecting this is how relatives might behave?

definitions.text: this is how relatives might behave?
definitions.meaning: the manner that members of a household might act, read literally

explanation.surface: A wry question about how kinsfolk might be expected to behave.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an old euphemism for being pregnant; read literally it describes behaving like a family.

clue.text: See 12
Get over Uncle Arthur not being all there

indicators.note: only part of the two words is present, so the answer lies within them

explanation.surface: An elderly relative is getting confused, but someone must overcome it.
explanation.definitionFit: To clear a fence or hurdle is to get over it.

clue.text: Whistle-blower, female, upset about story which has its ups and downs

definitions.text: which has its ups and downs

indicators.note: the official's word goes about the story

parts.note: a referee blows a whistle
a lie is a made-up story

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the woman's name upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: Pam is a female name

explanation.surface: A whistle-blowing woman is upset by a tale told about her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Whistle-blower' suggests an informant, but is the referee. 'Ups and downs' is literal: hills and valleys.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of map shows terrain in raised form, its hills and valleys literally going up and down.

clue.text: Supply bride's undies, 50% off or free

indicators.note: read as the adverb of supple, it means bending loosely, so the letters are reshaped
only half of the word is kept, the first three of its six letters

explanation.surface: An offer of discounted lingerie for a bride, or perhaps it comes free.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supply' looks like a verb but is the adverb from supple, the anagram signal; with UND, the first half of 'undies', it scrambles BRIDES UND.
explanation.definitionFit: To disburden is to relieve of a load, freeing someone from it.

clue.text: Daughter with primarily electric vehicle one belittles

indicators.note: primarily means first, so the opening letter is taken

parts.note: a tractor is a farm vehicle

explanation.surface: A daughter with an electric car whom someone mocks.
explanation.definitionFit: A detractor is a critic who disparages others, belittling them.

clue.text: Nobel Prize winner whose parents include one resident in US city twice

indicators.note: the parent words hold the rest inside them

parts.note: da and ma are informal names for father and mother

indicators.note: the single letter lives inside the doubled city
the city's abbreviation is written two times

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A prize-winner whose parents share a house with a lodger in an American city.
explanation.walkthrough: Da and Ma are homely words for father and mother; the doubled city sits between them with I lodged in its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: The 14th Dalai Lama, the Tibetan spiritual leader, received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1989.

clue.text: Answer to first clue might be this? That's beside the point

definitions.text: Answer to first clue might be this?
definitions.meaning: two men who swear a pact of loyalty are often not kin at all
something irrelevant has no bearing on the matter

explanation.surface: A puzzle remark pointing back to the opening clue, then dismissing it as irrelevant.
explanation.walkthrough: The first clue is 1 Across: sworn brothers are usually not family.
explanation.definitionFit: Something irrelevant has no connection, and sworn brothers have no family connection.

clue.text: Backstory about island port

indicators.note: the reversed story goes about the island letter

parts.note: a story read back: tale written backwards

explanation.surface: The backstory of an island port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Backstory' looks like one word, but splits: 'Back' reverses 'story' (TALE), giving ELAT, which goes about I.
explanation.definitionFit: Eilat is Israel's port on the Red Sea, at the top of the Gulf of Aqaba.

clue.text: Strange rites in South Africa caught by tense film

indicators.note: the scrambled word goes in the country's abbreviation
strange suggests odd, so the letters of the word are rearranged

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
T is a standard abbreviation for tense in grammar

explanation.surface: A tense movie about bizarre rituals in South Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strange' scrambles the rituals' letters into ISTER; C is the cricket abbreviation for caught.
explanation.definitionFit: Sister Act is the 1992 comedy starring Whoopi Goldberg as a singer hiding in a convent.

clue.text: Second film from TV series is overwhelming success

parts.note: M*A*S*H was a film before it became a long-running TV series

explanation.surface: A sequel spun off from a TV show turns into a huge hit.
explanation.walkthrough: M*A*S*H, a 1970 Korean War comedy film, spawned the hit TV series.
explanation.definitionFit: A smash is a huge hit, as in a smash-hit show.

clue.text: Relationship that is being preserved?

indicators.note: being in its container, the abbreviation sits inside the preserving word

parts.note: food that is preserved is tinned, kept in a tin
i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about whether a relationship is being kept going.
explanation.walkthrough: 'preserved' means tinned, as food in a can, so 'being preserved' puts the abbreviation into the can.
explanation.definitionFit: A tie-in is a connection or link between things, such as a book linked to a film.

clue.text: Get to replace content of this sign

indicators.note: the inside letters of the short word are swapped for another word

parts.note: to get a prize is to win it

explanation.surface: An instruction to go and swap what's in a sign.
explanation.walkthrough: 'this' keeps T and S; its inner HI gives way to WIN.
explanation.definitionFit: The Twins are Gemini, one of the twelve signs of the zodiac.

clue.text: Understood this topless dress is wrong for 20

indicators.note: mixed up together, the pieces give the cross-referenced film's letters

parts.note: the answer to 20 across, a film title

indicators.note: topless removes the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A nun's outfit, minus its top, is the wrong costume for a convent comedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'this' (the answer) plus RESS ('topless dress') is an anagram of SISTER ACT, so the answer is SISTER ACT less RESS, rearranged. 'Dress' suggests a habit, a false path.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tacit is implied without being stated, simply understood.

clue.text: Let in again to study at place of learning

parts.note: to read a subject at university is to study it
MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

explanation.surface: Being readmitted to university to study.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain one 'reads' a subject at university.
explanation.definitionFit: To readmit someone is to allow them back in a second time.

clue.text: Bind companion into a 9 arrangement

indicators.note: the companion goes into the rearranged letters
the letters of the words are set in a new arrangement

parts.note: the number nine spelt out, with the article
CH is the abbreviation for Companion of Honour

explanation.surface: Binding a friend into some sort of nine-part formation.
explanation.walkthrough: '9' is the number, not 9 Down. 'arrangement' scrambles A NINE into ENAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: To enchain is to bind someone in chains, or to hold them fast.

clue.text: Playing teen, first of his two parts in film

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters are being played with, rearranged
first of asks for the opening letter
two asks for the word to be written twice

parts.note: each of the two parts is a part

explanation.surface: An actor plays a teenager, the first of his two roles in a movie.
explanation.walkthrough: TEEN, H and PART PART are rearranged. The film is about twins, so Lohan really did play two parts.
explanation.definitionFit: The Parent Trap is the Disney comedy about twins scheming to reunite their parents, remade with Lindsay Lohan.
